content.text: The clause matches our preferred position exactly, with no arbitration provision anywhere in the document.

input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement and each dispute arising from it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
input.rationale: Section 28 selects New York law (with CISG disclaimed) and gives the state and federal courts in New York County exclusive jurisdiction, with mutual submission to personal jurisdiction and waiver of venue objections. A document-wide search returns no arbitration provision and no competing governing-law clause. The carve-out for interim injunctive relief in another court and the pre-filing executive escalation (which expressly does not delay urgent relief or limitations-period filings) are mutual and do not displace the New York forum. This is the preferred position, so no redline is required.
